datasheet_identity.title: BZX84C2V4 THRU BZX84C75 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES (SOT-23 Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes)

extraction_notes: Family datasheet BZX84C2V4 through BZX84C75; BZX84C15 row: VZ min 13.8 V, nominal 15 V, max 15.6 V at IZT = 5 mA; ZZT maximum 30 ohm at IZT; ZZK maximum 200 ohm at IZK = 1.0 mA; typical temperature coefficient 9.2 to 13 mV/degC; admissible IZM = 5 mA (p. 2).

The 15 V curve in Fig.2 was digitized from the printed linear-voltage/log-current grid on p. 3. The PD = 300 mW limit line and family artwork make the high-current tail approximate; no interpolation was added.

Fig.5 Typical Capacitance, Fig.6 zener impedance, Fig.3 temperature coefficients, and Fig.4 leakage current are family-level plots against nominal zener voltage and were not extracted as per-part curves; no capacitance value is tabulated for an individual type.
